title: PCS Mains: Unsuccessful candidates allege irregularities, demand CBI probe

ai.summary: Unsuccessful candidates in Punjab's PCS Mains exam demanded a CBI probe after alleging irregularities in the selection process, including unexplained delays and discrepancies in shortlisting.

facts.claim: Unsuccessful candidates in Punjab's PCS Mains exam demanded a CBI probe after alleging irregularities in the selection process
facts.quote: Several candidates who were unsuccessful in the Punjab State Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination-2025 (PCS) Mains staged a protest outside the Punjab Public Service Commission (PPSC) office in Patiala on Tuesday, demanding a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into alleged irregularities in the selection process.

facts.claim: including unexplained delays and discrepancies in shortlisting
facts.quote: The protesting aspirants, who raised slogans against the commission and staged a sit-in outside its office, alleged unexplained delays and discrepancies in the selection process.
